title_en: How Is a Holding Actually Captured?

chapters.title: 为什么人数占优，还要等几个月？
chapters.title_en: Why wait months with so many soldiers?

utterances.zh: 五千多名士兵围着一座城，守军只有四百多。为什么还要等几个月？攻城武器、城墙缺口和强攻堡垒，分别能改变什么？
utterances.en: Over 5,000 soldiers besiege just over 400 defenders. Why wait months? What changes with siege weapons, a wall breach or an assault?
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
4月22省1506 occupiedtrue/occupier33388、siegeobservabletrue/active_siegenull、G25；通知围攻获胜/现在控制南撒克逊/9gold。typedArmy0=6384。Jan10首次记录→Apr22相隔102日，非完整内部工期。

utterances.zh: 这一期，从军队抵达一直看到城破。先读围攻窗口，再看真实变化，最后把这座城的结果接回整场战争。
utterances.en: Follow the army's arrival through capture: read the siege window, watch actual changes, then connect the holding's result to the war.
utterances.visual_note: New R0157 original bookmark context; does not prove R0156 siege numbers or state.

utterances.zh: 从一零六六年的威廉开始。他正在进行诺曼人征服英格兰的战争；这次跟着他的军队渡海，围攻南撒克逊的刘易斯。
utterances.en: Begin with William in 1066, during the Norman conquest of England. Follow his army across the Channel to besiege Lewes in South Seaxe.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
同War1原生norman_conquest_cb，Apr19四项0，Apr22战斗0囚犯0占领13计时0 total13/victoryfalse；before距城破3日，未隔离所有同期他城变化。 本场UI占领tooltip县项南撒克逊+13.2%，原生整分项13；这不是统一每城面值或所有战争通用cap。
utterances.visual_note: New R0157 original bookmark context; does not prove R0156 siege numbers or state.

utterances.zh: 这次使用一点二零点零点三原版。城防等级、守军、攻城武器和围攻事件，分别影响不同的环节；下面的规则也限定在这一版。
utterances.en: This is vanilla 1.20.0.3. Fort level, garrison, siege weapons and events affect different parts of the siege; the rules here are specific to this build.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: New R0157 original bookmark context; does not prove R0156 siege numbers or state.

utterances.zh: 剩余天数是按当前情况估算的。守军、每日围攻进展或事件效果变了，估计也会变；它并不是围攻开始时就定下来的倒计时。
utterances.en: Remaining days estimate the current state. Changes to the garrison, daily progress or events can change it; it is not a countdown fixed when the siege began.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 前两期讲过战争和战斗。这次只记住一点：打赢敌军，和占领一座据点，都会推进战争，但它们不是同一件事。
utterances.en: Earlier episodes covered war and battles. Keep one distinction: defeating an army and occupying a holding advance the war in different ways.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

chapters.title: 先确认：军队真的在围攻
chapters.title_en: First confirm the siege is actually under way

utterances.zh: 主力从诺曼底渡海，先抵达英格兰南岸。新招募的射石机还在另一支军队里，尚未参加刘易斯的围攻；买下来和真正到场是两步。
utterances.en: The main force lands first from Normandy. Newly recruited mangonels remain in another army; recruitment and arrival at Lewes are separate steps.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一零六七年一月十日，刘易斯围攻战正在推进。守军四百二十，实际参加这次围攻的兵力五千六百六十。
utterances.en: On 10 January 1067, the siege of Lewes is progressing: 420 defenders face 5,660 eligible participating soldiers.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 人数检查比较两边：真正参加这次围攻的士兵，和要塞现有守军。不是拿全地图兵力，也不是照搬军队的名义人数。
utterances.en: The troop check compares eligible siege participants with the fort's current garrison, rather than map-wide forces or nominal army strength.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 在已经存在的围攻中，假设守军四百二十、实际参围四百一十九。虽然只差一人，仍会卡在人数不足这一项。
utterances.en: In an existing siege, 419 eligible besiegers against 420 defenders fail the troop check, even though they are only one short.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 两边刚好都是四百二十，当前围攻就不因人数太少受阻。但还得符合其他条件，不能听成相等一定能开始、或一直推进。
utterances.en: At 420 against 420, insufficient numbers do not block this siege check. Other conditions still matter; equality alone does not guarantee starting or continued progress.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 行军或进入战斗，也可能影响围攻。进展停住，先读窗口的原因，再决定增加兵力、停下行军，还是处理附近的敌军。
utterances.en: Movement or battle can affect a siege. Read why progress stopped before choosing more troops, halting movement or dealing with nearby enemies.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这一次，我们人数足够，围攻进展也确实增加。军队站在城外，和军队正在围攻，是两回事；读完条件，再看窗口有没有真实推进。
utterances.en: Here there are enough troops and siege progress is increasing. Standing outside a holding and conducting its siege are different; confirm progress in the window.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 再读城防等级、守军和围攻进展。它们告诉我们离城破还有多远；兵力比对方多多少，不能独自回答要等多久。
utterances.en: Read fort level, garrison and siege progress to see how far capture is. The numerical advantage alone does not tell you how long to wait.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

chapters.title: 剩余天数为什么会往回跳？
chapters.title_en: Why does the time estimate increase?

utterances.zh: 刘易斯城防三级，起初守军四百二十。城防等级影响所需进展，也会检查攻城武器是否有足够的围攻等级。
utterances.en: Lewes has fort level 3 and initially 420 defenders. Fort level affects required progress and checks whether the weapons have a sufficient siege tier.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 进展提示列出已经累积的数值和需要达到的总数。为了算清楚，下面分别叫它累计进展和所需总进展，这是两种讲解用的称呼。
utterances.en: The progress tooltip lists the accumulated value and required total. For explanation, call them accumulated progress and required total progress.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 同样显示每天二点多，一座城还差几十点，另一座还差几百点，等的时间当然不同。每日速度只有放在还差多少进展旁边，才有完整意义。
utterances.en: Two sieges showing roughly two progress per day can have very different waits if one needs tens more points and the other hundreds. Read the rate beside the remaining work.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 用个简单示例：需要四百点，已经累积二百点，就是完成一半。把两个数一起看，才知道进度条为什么在这里。
utterances.en: For a simple example, 200 accumulated out of 400 required is halfway. Both values explain where the progress bar sits.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 所需总进展以一百为基础，再加城防等级乘七十五、乘守军比例。城防相同，守军状态不同，需要完成的总数也可能不同。
utterances.en: Required total progress is 100 plus fort level times 75 times the garrison ratio. The same fort can require different totals as its garrison changes.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 守军比例看当前守军占有效上限的多少，最多按满员算。越接近满员，城防增加的那部分进展就越完整。
utterances.en: The garrison ratio compares current strength with its effective maximum, capped at full. A fuller garrison gives the fort term more weight.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 例如城防四级、守军满员。一百加四乘七十五，共四百点。这是规则示例；刘易斯城防三级，不能直接套成它的当日数值。
utterances.en: For a full garrison at fort level four, 100 plus four times 75 is 400. This is a rule example; Lewes has fort level three.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 仍是四级城防，守军比例只有一半，城防增加的部分也减半。总数变成二百五十，已有进展离终点就更近。
utterances.en: At fort level four with a half-full garrison ratio, halve the fort term. The required total becomes 250, bringing accumulated progress closer to capture.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 所需总数会随守军状态变化。刚开始看到需要四百点，不代表后面的每一天，终点都固定在同样的四百。
utterances.en: The required total changes with garrison state. A starting requirement of 400 need not remain 400 for every later day.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 进度条走得更快，可能是每日进展更多，也可能是所需总数变少。百分比本身分不清；打开提示，才能看到哪一项变了。
utterances.en: A faster bar can mean more daily progress or a lower required total. Open the tooltip to distinguish the change.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月十日，刘易斯累计进展二点四六，所需总数约三百零五点四三，还不到百分之一。城外人数占优，城内仍有很长一段要围。
utterances.en: On 10 January, Lewes has 2.46 progress out of about 305.43, under one percent. Despite the army's advantage, capture remains far away.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 数值看清之后，让日历走一天。先看真实进展，再解释兵力和攻城武器的作用。
utterances.en: Let one day pass, observe the progress, then examine the roles of troops and siege weapons.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 每日围攻进展提示列着基础、兵士和围攻士兵等明细；当时总数显示二点四。查看这些项，比只凭人头判断快慢更可靠。
utterances.en: The daily-progress tooltip lists Base, Men-at-Arms and Besieging Soldiers, with a displayed total of 2.4. Read the breakdown rather than headcount alone.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月十日到十一日，完整过了一天。两端参围兵力五千六百六十、守军四百二十，所需总数也没有变化。
utterances.en: From 10 to 11 January, one full day passes with the same 5,660 besiegers, 420 defenders and required total at both endpoints.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 累计进展二点四六到四点九二，一天净增二点四六。这是这一日的真实变化，不是每场围攻都固定如此。
utterances.en: Progress rises from 2.46 to 4.92, a net daily gain of 2.46. This is the observed day rather than a fixed rate for every siege.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 界面约二点四，前后数值显示净增二点四六，预计从一百二十四变成一百二十三天。先确认围攻在推进，再比较之后的变化。
utterances.en: The UI shows about 2.4, the values gain 2.46, and the estimate falls from 124 to 123 days. The siege is progressing.
facts: 1月10→11实际24小时，同Siege6 C2.46→4.92净2.46，B/G/T未变，N124→123；UI显示2.4。不独立发布普通D或完整phase账本。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月十三日，守军读数由四百二十变成四百六十，需要达到的总进展增加到三百二十五。数字确实改变了，但仅凭这组画面，不能说明守军增加的原因。
utterances.en: On 13 January, the garrison reads 460 rather than 420, and required total progress rises to 325. These readings establish the change, but not its cause.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 这一天仍增加二点四六进展，预计却从一百二十二天延后到一百二十九天。军队没有白围一天，只是按当前要求，离终点又远了一些。
utterances.en: Progress still gains 2.46 that day, but the estimate rises from 122 to 129 days. The day was not wasted; the current requirement places the target farther away.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 所以看到剩余天数突然增加，不必先怀疑军队不再推进。对照守军、累计进展和所需总数，才能分清是速度变了，还是需要完成的进展变了。
utterances.en: When remaining days jump, compare the garrison, accumulated progress and required total. Distinguish a changed rate from a changed requirement.
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

chapters.title: 另一支军队与攻城武器，怎样改变推进？
chapters.title_en: What changes when another army and its weapons arrive?

utterances.zh: 更多参围士兵可以影响兵力项，攻城武器另有贡献。因此另一支军队到场，要看带来多少人，也要看带来什么武器。
utterances.en: More eligible soldiers affect the troop term, while siege weapons contribute separately. Check an arriving army's equipment as well as its strength.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 提示里的兵士、围攻士兵不是同一项：兵士来自军团的围攻贡献，围攻士兵看参围兵力比守军多多少。别把两个名字混成一个数。
utterances.en: Men-at-Arms and Besieging Soldiers are separate tooltip terms: regiment siege contributions and the bonus from eligible troops exceeding the garrison.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 最初，攻城武器一栏显示六十，是已有部队的合计。它不是刚招募那团射石机的数量；新团还没有到刘易斯。
utterances.en: Initially the siege-weapons field shows 60 from existing troops. That is not the new mangonel regiment, which has not reached Lewes yet.
facts: 1067年1月10日首次记录自军Siege6/刘易斯省1506：B5660 G420 fort3 C2.46 T305.434 N124；不是内部建立tick。
本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 射石机招募提示显示每日围攻进展增加零点三，有效最大城防十级。一个是推进贡献，一个是能应付的城防范围。
utterances.en: The mangonel tooltip shows +0.3 daily siege progress and an effective fort limit of 10: contribution and fort coverage are separate properties.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.
utterances.condition: Current-case army actually has the referenced siege engine; otherwise remove or rewrite before freeze.

utterances.zh: 新团规模一，每规模军团士兵数是十人，初始只有五人。军团补员和整支军队抵达围攻地点，要分开看，不能都含糊地叫增援。
utterances.en: The new regiment has size one, ten soldiers per size, and initially five. Distinguish its replenishment from the army's arrival at the siege.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.
utterances.condition: Current-case army actually has the referenced siege engine; otherwise remove or rewrite before freeze.

utterances.zh: 招募时，金钱从七百二十八变为六百六十八点六，支出五十九点四。成立军团是第一步，接着还得行军到场。
utterances.en: Recruitment changes gold from 728 to 668.6, a cost of 59.4. Creating the regiment is the first step; its army must still arrive.
facts: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 攻城武器贡献按当前士兵数所占的规模换算，再乘有效围攻数值，最后逐军团相加；不能把原始人数直接乘满规模面板值。
utterances.en: Scale each regiment's effective siege value by its current soldiers divided by soldiers per size, then add the regiments. Do not multiply the full-size value by raw headcount.
facts: 逐团effective siege_value乘归一化current count/stack，不是原始人数乘stock。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 每规模十人，当前五人，按半个规模算；当前十人才是完整规模。因此刚建立和满员以后，不能当成相同的贡献。
utterances.en: With ten soldiers per size, five soldiers fill half of size one, and ten fill it completely. A newly formed and a full regiment contribute differently.

facts.observation: New mangonel regiment: size1, ten soldiers per size, initial5/10; current-count contribution must be distinguished from later arrival and merge.

utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.
origin_facts_before_revision_a03: 本案射石机招募tooltip：一档10、+.3/天、有效最大城防10；初始5/10；gold728→668.6净59.4。原有60围攻兵不是新购团。

utterances.zh: 每日围攻进展和有效最大城防，分别回答推进多少、能应付多高城防。比较武器，别只读其中一个数。
utterances.en: Daily siege progress and the maximum effective fort level answer different questions: contribution and coverage. Read both when comparing weapons.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 超过有效城防，不等于整场围攻自动停止。接下来要看城防跨了哪些门槛，我们的围攻等级能不能覆盖。
utterances.en: Exceeding the effective fort limit does not automatically stop the siege. Check reached fort thresholds against the available siege tier.
facts: 静态规则或明确条件算例，非未观测的本案结果。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 城防还会检查围攻等级能否覆盖已达到的门槛。每道没有覆盖的门槛，都给速度再乘一层惩罚。
utterances.en: Fort level checks whether the siege tier covers reached thresholds. Each uncovered threshold adds another multiplicative speed penalty.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这一版的门槛是四、六、十一、十六、三十一。达到就检查，例如四级已经达到第一道，不必再高一级。
utterances.en: This build's thresholds are 4, 6, 11, 16 and 31. The check starts at the threshold itself: level four reaches the first.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 每道无法覆盖的门槛，都乘零点七。两道无法覆盖，就连续乘两次，不是从原速度减去两份相同数值。
utterances.en: Each uncovered threshold multiplies speed by 0.7. Two thresholds mean two multiplications, rather than two equal subtractions.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 城防四级，达到第一道门槛。没有足够围攻等级覆盖，速度乘零点七，剩下原来的七成。
utterances.en: At fort level four, without a siege tier covering the first threshold, speed is multiplied by 0.7, retaining seventy percent.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 城防六级达到两道门槛。两道都覆盖不了，零点七乘零点七，最后是原速度的百分之四十九。
utterances.en: At fort level six, if neither reached threshold is covered, 0.7 times 0.7 leaves forty-nine percent of the original speed.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 最高可用围攻等级是一，第一道能覆盖，第二道不能。面对六级城防，这时只乘一次零点七。
utterances.en: With highest eligible siege tier one, the first threshold is covered but the second is not. Against level six, apply 0.7 once.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果

facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果

chapters.title: 围攻事件和城墙缺口
chapters.title_en: Siege events and breaches in the walls

utterances.zh: 围攻事件有不同作用：有的缩短事件间隔，有的直接增加进展，有的提高每日进展。先看事件名称，再看它改了哪一项。
utterances.en: Events differ: some shorten the interval, some add progress, and others increase daily progress. Read the event name before its effect.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 普通每日进展先加入；达到所需总数，就完成围攻。否则到了事件结算时，再按事件类型处理，不是每次都额外加进展。
utterances.en: Daily progress is added first and can complete the siege. Otherwise a due event resolves by type, rather than always adding extra progress.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 事件间隔以二十天为基础，修正和城墙缺口会改变它。等待事件时，普通每日进展仍然继续累积。
utterances.en: Event intervals start from twenty days and change with modifiers and breaches. Ordinary daily progress continues between events.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 进度条突然跳一截，先看最近事件，再看所需总数。不要只凭这一跳，就把它当成每日速度突然翻倍。
utterances.en: If the bar jumps, check the latest event and required total before concluding that daily speed doubled.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月二十七日，城墙出现小缺口，前一天还没有。这个新状态，给我们打开了考虑强攻堡垒的选择。
utterances.en: On 27 January, the walls have a small breach where the previous day had none. That new state opens the possibility of assaulting the fort.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 城墙破损是事件，小缺口和大缺口是状态。粮食、疾病、守军逃亡和僵持的效果又不同，不能都当成同一种加速。
utterances.en: Breach is an event; Small Breach and Large Breach are wall states. Starvation, Disease Outbreak, Desertion and Stalemate have different effects.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 小缺口缩短事件间隔百分之十，大缺口缩短百分之三十。改变的是事件间隔，不是把城防等级直接清零。
utterances.en: Small and large breaches reduce the event interval by ten and thirty percent. They change the interval rather than simply erasing fort level.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 只算缺口修正，二十天分别变成十八天、十四天。实际还会有其他修正，所以小缺口不保证下一次事件恰好十八天后。
utterances.en: With only the breach modifier, twenty days becomes eighteen or fourteen. Other modifiers mean a small breach does not guarantee an event eighteen days later.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 粮食满仓变为缺粮，增加当时所需总进展的百分之五；再变为断粮，又增加当时总数的百分之十五，是另加的一笔。
utterances.en: A supply shortage adds five percent of the current required total. Starvation adds another fifteen percent of the then-current total.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 示例里，两次总数都是四百、还没完成围攻。首次增加二十点，第二次另加六十点，不是把首次增加改成六十。
utterances.en: If both totals are 400 and the siege is unfinished, first add twenty and then another sixty. The later gain does not replace the earlier one.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 疾病蔓延使每日进展增加百分之十，疾病猖獗是百分之二十。按当前状态算二十，不把两个状态叠成三十。
utterances.en: Spreading disease adds ten percent to the daily-rate multiplier; rampant disease adds twenty. Use the current state, rather than stacking them into thirty.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 守军逃亡额外增加五点围攻进展。这里不是百分之五，也不是说画面已经证明刚好少了五名守军。
utterances.en: Desertion adds five progress points, not five percent or evidence that exactly five defenders disappeared.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 事件机会会随攻城武器、城防和当前状态改变。先过滤哪些事件还能出现，再算它们的机会，不是固定不变的概率表。
utterances.en: Weapons, forts and current states change which events remain eligible and their chances. This is not a permanently fixed probability table.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这次小缺口出现的一日，净增二点七八进展。那是整天的变化，不能全部当成城墙破损额外送出的奖励。
utterances.en: This small-breach day gains 2.78 progress overall. The entire day's gain is not an extra wall-damage reward.

utterances.zh: 没有合格围攻等级，这次抽取就不给城墙破损机会。想等出缺口再强攻，先看武器条件，不能把一直等当成保证。
utterances.en: Without an eligible siege tier, this draw gives wall damage no chance. Check the weapons rather than assuming waiting guarantees a breach.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 僵持不增加额外事件进展，但当天普通进展已经先加入。“事件没有帮忙”，不等于“这一天完全没推进”。
utterances.en: Stalemate adds no extra event progress, but daily progress has already been applied. An unhelpful event does not mean a whole day without progress.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 缺口、粮食和疾病达到最高状态，就不再抽同类升级。能出现的事件变了，其余事件之间的机会也随之改变。
utterances.en: At their maximum level, breach, food and disease upgrades are excluded. Changing the eligible events changes the remaining chances.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月二十九日，进展五十二点零八，总数三百二十五，预计九十九天。围攻事件一栏另显示十六天，两处天数要分开读。
utterances.en: On 29 January, progress is 52.08 of 325 and the estimate is 99 days. The event display also shows sixteen days; read these separately.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 十六天是当前围攻事件间隔，不是从现在还剩十六天。小缺口会缩短间隔，但不能用它独自解释其他所有修正。
utterances.en: Sixteen days is the current event interval, not sixteen days still to wait. The small breach affects it but does not explain every modifier.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。
utterances.visual_note: Exact actual source pins in live-source facts; static example labeled separately.

utterances.zh: 强攻堡垒可以按，和现在值得按，是两回事。先比较它预计增加的进展、可能损失的兵力，再决定继续等还是强攻。
utterances.en: An available assault is not automatically worthwhile. Compare projected progress and manpower losses before choosing waiting or assault.
facts: 1月26→27 breach0→1，同Siege6 C43.74→46.52净2.78；1月29C52.08/T325/N99，smallbreach tooltip -10%，currentphase显示16天，来源未完整归因。

chapters.title: 继续等，还是强攻堡垒？
chapters.title_en: Keep waiting, or assault the fort?

utterances.zh: 有了缺口，比较继续等与强攻堡垒。当前还要等多久、预计会少多少兵，放在一起看才好选择。
utterances.en: With a breach, compare waiting with assault. Read the current time estimate alongside projected troop losses before choosing.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 强攻需要城墙缺口，参围兵力不能少于守军，围攻本身还要能够进行。只看到缺口，不保证按钮就可用。
utterances.en: Assault requires a breach, enough eligible troops and a siege able to continue. A breach alone does not guarantee an available button.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一月二十九日，小缺口、参围六千七百四十六，强攻堡垒可用。我们这次只试一天，之后重新判断。
utterances.en: On 29 January, a small breach and 6,746 eligible soldiers make assault available. We try one day, then reassess.
facts: 1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 预估每天额外增加十三点六进展、损失一百六十八。十三点六是进展数值，不是直接增加十三点六个百分点。
utterances.en: The preview shows 13.6 extra progress daily and 168 projected losses. That is progress, not 13.6 percentage points of the bar.
facts: 1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 预计损失看参围兵力与缺口状态。小缺口按百分之二点五，大缺口按百分之一，缺口大小也影响强攻的预计代价。
utterances.en: Projected losses use eligible strength and breach state: 2.5 percent for a small breach and one percent for a large breach.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 一千名参围士兵的示例，分别是二十五、十的预计损失。这是在解释按钮预估，不是本次实战损失。
utterances.en: For an example of 1,000 eligible soldiers, projected losses are 25 or ten. These explain the preview rather than this siege's observed losses.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 预估只描述现在。兵力、守军变了，再看按钮，数字也可能变；继续强攻之前，要重新判断代价。
utterances.en: The preview describes the present state. If troops or garrison change, recheck the button and reassess the cost before continuing.
facts: 静态原版规则/算例，非本次实机结果
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 想更快拿城，也得问自己能否承担这批兵力损失。按钮给出的是当前预估，不是一份保证；兵力用掉之后，后续战斗和围攻还要继续考虑。
utterances.en: Faster capture also raises a manpower question. The button gives a current projection rather than a guarantee; consider the force needed for later battles and sieges.
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 按下强攻堡垒，窗口显示强攻进行中。一月二十九日到三十日，我们看这场围攻实际过一天的结果。
utterances.en: Start the assault and the window shows it in progress. Follow this siege from 29 to 30 January to see the actual one-day result.
facts: 1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 进展五十二点零八到六十八点四六，净增十六点三八。参围兵力六千七百四十六到六千五百七十八，净少一百六十八。
utterances.en: Progress rises from 52.08 to 68.46, gaining 16.38. Eligible strength falls from 6,746 to 6,578, a net decrease of 168.
facts: 1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。
utterances.visual_note: Exact William Siege6 source only; static examples visibly labeled. Raw clip spans require independently reviewed actual PTS. No prior case evidence transferred.

utterances.zh: 这次兵力净少，恰好符合开始时的预估。十六点三八却是整日总进展，不全是强攻额外值；下一天也不保证重复相同结果。
utterances.en: The net troop decrease matches this preview. The 16.38 is the day's total gain, not entirely extra assault progress or a guarantee about the next day.
facts: 1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。

utterances.zh: 下一次预估已经是十三点二进展、一百六十四损失。军队状态变了，预计收益和代价也跟着变。
utterances.en: The next preview is already 13.2 progress and 164 losses. A changed army state changes the projected gains and costs.
facts: 1月29有合法一级破口：开始回读flag true，日预览13.6work/168人；1月29→30同Siege6 C52.08→68.46净16.38，有效参围B6746→6578净-168；不隔离纯强攻贡献或逐团死亡。次预览13.2/164。

utterances.zh: 停止强攻后，进展仍是六十八点四六，预计九十三天。后面恢复普通围攻，之前积累的进展并没有被抹掉。
utterances.en: After stopping, progress remains 68.46 and the estimate is 93 days. Ordinary siege resumes without erasing the accumulated progress.
